entities.summary: Artur Mas i Gavarró is a Catalan politician from Spain. He was president of the Government of Catalonia from 2010 to 2015 and acting president from September 2015 to 12 January 2016. Artur Mas was a performers & entertainers from Barcelona (b. 1956-01-31, Barcelona). A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to economic history and geopolitics.
